model_regions: single isotropic material for the whole implant body; no grading, no declared anisotropy
fabrication_note: Not printable on Formlabs SLA printers. The .form is a geometry carrier only; its print setting is not the declared material.

E_MPa.selection_note: Value chosen from inside the published range because it is closest to bone E3 = 714 MPa. It is not the range midpoint (650 MPa).
E_MPa.source: Hussain M, Naqvi RA, Abbas N, Khan SM, Nawaz S, Hussain A, Zahra N, Khalid MW. Ultra-High-Molecular-Weight-Polyethylene (UHMWPE) as a Promising Polymer Material for Biomedical Applications: A Concise Review. Polymers 2020;12(2):323.
E_MPa.locator: Table 1, row 'Modulus of elasticity (GPa)', column UHMWPE

strength_MPa.type: tensile yield, low end of published range
strength_MPa.locator: Table 1, row 'Tensile yield strength (MPa)', column UHMWPE

table_context.caption: Average properties of Ultra-High Molecular Weight Polyethylene (UHMWPE) and high-density polyethylene (HDPE).
table_context.attribution: The table is marked as reprinted from Kurtz, UHMWPE Biomaterials Handbook (the article's ref. 7). The handbook itself was not opened.

conflicting_evidence.summary: Measured compressive properties are well below the declared E, and the measured nu is below the declared nu. An interbody implant is loaded mainly in compression, so the declared E may overstate its real stiffness.
conflicting_evidence.source: Abdelgaied A, Fisher J, Jennings L. The Compressive Mechanical Properties of UHMWPE for the Use in Computational Models of Total Knee Replacements. Orthopaedic Proceedings 2017;99-B(SUPP_3):1.
quotes: The measured Poisson's ratio was 0.33±0.04 (mean ± 95% confidence interval (CI), n=5)
The corresponding values for the equivalent elastic modulus were 365±31 and 553±51
conflicting_evidence.why_not_declared: It gives lower E, which raises H (see below), and no yield strength was seen in the text read. It is a conference abstract, and 'equivalent' modulus may not equal the small-strain E the judge uses.

effect_on_H_from_replica.caveat: Our replica, not the judge. Generic shapes at h=0.4 mm, no Richardson, not the final implant. H_vis is visible cases only.
effect_on_H_from_replica.reading: nu = 0.46 about triples H at E 700 on the tube but H stays small. If the true compressive E were 500 MPa, H would be about 3.7x the declared-value figure. No run covered E 365 at this shape and nu.

Whether the judge's checker accepts a value picked from inside a range is untested. If it fails, spec section 5 replaces the property from the nearest reference entry; p2's fallback run covers E 1136.
